return features[moduleId] || []; }; const getStatusColor = (status) => { switch(status) { case 'ready': return 'bg-green-100 text-green-800'; case 'processing': return 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800'; case 'error': return 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'; default: return 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'; } }; const renderModulePage = () => { switch(activeModule) { case 'scraper': return ; case 'cleaning': return ;
